sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT 1 AS q_num, date '2025-01-01' AS q_start, date '2025-04-01' AS q_end
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, date '2025-04-01', date '2025-07-01'
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, date '2025-07-01', date '2025-10-01'
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, date '2025-10-01', date '2026-01-01'
),
m AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM tenants WHERE name IN ('Cragsley Outfitters','Marrowby & Vane','Studio Vrij','Grind Collective')
)
SELECT
  m.name AS merchant_name,
  '2025-Q' || q.q_num AS quarter,
  count(tk.id) AS urgent_tickets_evaluated,
  round(
    100.0 * sum(
      case when tk.id is not null
             and (tk.resolved_at is null or tk.resolved_at > tk.created_at + (sp.resolution_target_minutes || ' minutes')::interval)
           then 1 else 0 end
    )::numeric / nullif(count(tk.id), 0)
  , 1) AS urgent_miss_rate_pct,
  round(
    avg(case when tk.resolved_at is not null then extract(epoch from tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 end)::numeric
  , 1) AS avg_actual_resolution_hours,
  round(
    percentile_cont(0.5) within group (
      order by case when tk.resolved_at is not null then extract(epoch from tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 end
    )::numeric
  , 1) AS median_actual_resolution_hours
FROM m
CROSS JOIN q
LEFT JOIN tickets tk
  ON tk.tenant_id = m.id
  AND tk.priority = 'urgent'
  AND tk.sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL
  AND tk.created_at >= q.q_start AND tk.created_at < q.q_end
LEFT JOIN sla_policies sp ON sp.id = tk.sla_policy_id
GROUP BY m.name, q.q_num
ORDER BY m.name ASC, q.q_num ASC
note: Built a full 4-tenant x 4-quarter grid with LEFT JOIN so quarters with zero evaluable urgent tickets still print a row (count 0, miss rate/avg/median NULL) instead of silently vanishing. Miss rate denominator and avg/median are strictly over tickets with sla_policy_id not null, per the 'evaluable' definition; resolved_at null is treated as a miss since data ends 2025-12-31.
